SERVICES_LIST.NAME: Electrical Installations
SERVICES_LIST.DESCRIPTION: Medium and low voltage for industrial, commercial, and residential settings

PROJECTS_LIST.NAME: Teleperformance One Tower
PROJECTS_LIST.DESCRIPTION: A fire detection system and a fire suppression system using hydrants were installed across 10 levels of the tower.

PROJECTS_LIST.NAME: Ethan Allen
PROJECTS_LIST.DESCRIPTION: A sprinkler system was installed, with a 2,500 GPM pump on floors 1 and 2, as well as a SafeFire cable thermal detection system connected to a Notifier panel, complying with NFPA standards and under supervision and approval of the international insurance company.

PROJECTS_LIST.NAME: Advanced Composites
PROJECTS_LIST.DESCRIPTION: A residential diesel pump with UL/FM certification was replaced, complying with NFPA 20 requirements, along with the head assembly and connection to the existing system.

PROJECTS_LIST.NAME: Bulkmatic de México
PROJECTS_LIST.DESCRIPTION: This system was developed from scratch based on NFPA standards. The installation includes a 1500 GPM pumping unit that feeds a sprinkler system in the transfer area and monitoring hydrants. An alarm system was also installed in the transfer area, sprinklers in the pump room, and spot detection in the office area.
